description: C02 — 法国防御推进变例，锁定兵链最清晰形态

intro.popup_en: Pawn-Chain Direction, Lesson 2: In the Advance Variation, White plays e5 on move three to lock the structure immediately. Black should attack the base on d4 with ...c5, while White can prepare b4-b5 on the queenside. The two sides race on opposite wings.
intro.popup:
兵链方向第2课
e5推进变例！
白方第3步直接e5
立刻锁定兵链，结构第一！
c5要攻根部d4
b4→b5要推后翼
双翼竞速！

outro.popup_en: This game demonstrates how a pawn-chain advance shapes both sides' plans and directs the attack toward opposite wings.
outro.popup: 本局演示了兵链推进的例子！

moves.popup_en: ...e6 begins the French Defense.
e5!! The Advance Variation locks the pawn chain e5-d4 in place, defining the structure immediately.
moves.popup:
e5！！推进变例！一步锁定兵链e5-d4
结构立刻确立！

moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black correctly attacks the base of White's chain on d4, the key counterattack in the Advance Variation.
moves.popup:
c5！正确！攻击兵链根部d4
——推进变例黑方核心反击！

moves.popup_en: c3! White reinforces the base on d4 and holds the pawn chain together.
moves.popup: c3！支撑兵链根部d4，坚守链根

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops a knight.
Nf3 develops and prepares White's kingside setup.
...Qb6! Black develops the queen and creates double pressure against b2.
Bd3 develops and supports the pawn on e5.
...Bd7 develops Black's bishop.
O-O secures White's king.
...cxd4! Black finally strikes at the base of the chain on d4.
cxd4 recaptures and rebuilds White's pawn chain.
...Nge7 develops Black's knight.
Nc3 develops and brings another piece toward the kingside.
...Nf5 places Black's knight on an active square.
Na4! White drives away Black's queen.
...Qa5 retreats the queen.
Bd2 develops the bishop.
...Bb4+ gives check with the bishop.
Bb1! The bishop retreats to protect White's queenside.
...O-O secures Black's king.
a3! White drives Black's knight away.
...Nc6 retreats the knight.
b4!! White begins the queenside pawn race. The chain's direction clearly guides the plan.
moves.popup:
b4！！双翼竞速！b4后翼推进
兵链方向清晰指引行动！

moves.popup_en: ...Qd8 retreats the queen.
b5!! White launches a minority attack and advances along the queenside.
moves.popup: b5！！少数兵突破！沿后翼推进

moves.popup_en: ...Na5 reroutes the knight.
Ne1!! White reorganizes the knight, preparing Nf3-g5 or f5 and a later f4 break on the kingside.
moves.popup:
Ne1！！战略重组
调马去f3→g5/f5，准备f4王翼突破

moves.popup_en: ...f6! Black attacks the head of White's pawn chain on e5.
exf6! White captures and exchanges pawns.
...Rxf6! Black's rook recaptures and becomes active.
